commands.command: /bin/zsh -lc "find .. -maxdepth 3 \\( -name 'AGENTS.md' -o -name 'CLAUDE.md' -o -name 'README.md' -o -name 'package.json' -o -name 'pnpm-lock.yaml' -o -name 'Cargo.toml' -o -name 'go.mod' -o -name 'pyproject.toml' \\) -print"
/bin/zsh -lc "rg --files -g '"'!*node_modules*'"' -g '"'!*.png'"' -g '"'!*.jpg'"' -g '"'!*.jpeg'"' -g '"'!*.gif'"' | sed -n '1,200p'"
/bin/zsh -lc 'pwd && git status --short --branch && git remote -v'
/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,220p' README.md"
/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,220p' CLAUDE.md"
/bin/zsh -lc 'git log --oneline --decorate -n 12 --all'
/bin/zsh -lc 'git fetch origin main --prune && git rev-parse origin/main && git rev-parse HEAD && git branch --show-current'
/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,260p' docs/rules/conventions.md"
/bin/zsh -lc 'git show-ref --heads --remotes | sort'
/bin/zsh -lc 'git config --get-all remote.origin.fetch && git config --get-all branch.main.merge || true'
/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,260p' docs/rules/testing.md"
/bin/zsh -lc "find tests -maxdepth 4 -type f | sort | sed -n '1,240p'"
/bin/zsh -lc "find docs/plans docs/releases docs/design -maxdepth 4 -type f | rg -i 'auth|permission|migration|t1438|t1441|effective|profile|access' | sort | sed -n '1,220p'"

/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n \"authz|authorization|permission|permissions|profile|Profile|migration|rollback|revoke|revocation|CAS|cache|fail closed|fail-closed|MCP|mcp|background|project scope|direct union|effective\" -S internal cmd tests web/src docs | sed -n '1,260p'"
/bin/zsh -lc 'git fetch origin refs/heads/main:refs/remotes/origin/main && git rev-parse origin/main && git status --short'
/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,260p' docs/design/decisions/0058-unified-permission-contract.md"
/bin/zsh -lc 'git checkout -B review/t1441-independent-authz-acceptance origin/main && git rev-parse HEAD && git status --short --branch'
/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,320p' docs/design/features/2026-08-20-t1435-dual-profile-ram-access-contract.md"
/bin/zsh -lc "find internal -maxdepth 4 -type f | rg 'authorization|permission|access|ram|identity|mcp|worker|webconsole' | sort | sed -n '1,260p'"
/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,260p' Makefile"

/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n \"T1438|T1413|T1416|fail closed|fail-closed|revoke|revokes|CAS|stale|direct|union|project|background|Transport|MCP|HTTP|Web|cache|readiness|shadow|legacy|enforce\" internal/authorization internal/admin/api internal/webconsole/api internal/mcphost internal/team/service internal/persistence web/src/pages/Access.test.tsx web/src/pages/TeamDetail.test.tsx web/src/pages/AiRuntime.test.tsx | sed -n '1,420p'"
/bin/zsh -lc "find . -maxdepth 3 -type f \\( -name '*README*' -o -name '*plan*' -o -name '*task*' \\) | sort | sed -n '1,240p'"
/bin/zsh -lc "ls -la && ls -la docs/acceptance docs/releases docs/plans 2>/dev/null | sed -n '1,240p'"

/bin/zsh -lc "mkdir -p docs/acceptance/t1441/logs && { date -u; git rev-parse origin/main; git rev-parse HEAD; go version; node --version 2>/dev/null || true; pnpm --version 2>/dev/null || true; } > docs/acceptance/t1441/logs/00-environment.txt 2>&1 && sed -n '1,80p' docs/acceptance/t1441/logs/00-environment.txt"

/bin/zsh -lc "set -o pipefail
{
  echo '"'$ go test ./internal/persistence ./internal/authorization ./internal/team/service ./internal/webconsole/api ./internal/admin/api ./internal/mcphost ./internal/cli ./internal/workerdaemon'"'
  go test ./internal/persistence ./internal/authorization ./internal/team/service ./internal/webconsole/api ./internal/admin/api ./internal/mcphost ./internal/cli ./internal/workerdaemon
} > docs/acceptance/t1441/logs/10-go-targeted.log 2>&1
code="'$?
tail -120 docs/acceptance/t1441/logs/10-go-targeted.log
exit $code'

/bin/zsh -lc "{
  echo '"'$ cd web && pnpm test -- --run src/pages/Access.test.tsx src/pages/TeamDetail.test.tsx src/pages/AiRuntime.test.tsx'"'
  cd web && pnpm test -- --run src/pages/Access.test.tsx src/pages/TeamDetail.test.tsx src/pages/AiRuntime.test.tsx
} > docs/acceptance/t1441/logs/11-web-targeted.log 2>&1
code="'$?
tail -160 docs/acceptance/t1441/logs/11-web-targeted.log
exit $code'
/bin/zsh -lc "find . -path '*11-web-targeted.log' -print -maxdepth 5 && pwd && ls -la docs/acceptance/t1441/logs && ls -la web/docs/acceptance/t1441/logs 2>/dev/null || true"
/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,220p' docs/acceptance/t1441/logs/11-web-targeted.log; exit 0"

/bin/zsh -lc '(cd web && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile) > docs/acceptance/t1441/logs/11a-web-pnpm-install.log 2>&1
code=$?
tail -120 docs/acceptance/t1441/logs/11a-web-pnpm-install.log
exit $code'

/bin/zsh -lc "{
  echo '"'$ (cd web && pnpm test -- --run src/pages/Access.test.tsx src/pages/TeamDetail.test.tsx src/pages/AiRuntime.test.tsx)'"'
  (cd web && pnpm test -- --run src/pages/Access.test.tsx src/pages/TeamDetail.test.tsx src/pages/AiRuntime.test.tsx)
} > docs/acceptance/t1441/logs/12-web-targeted-after-install.log 2>&1
code="'$?
tail -160 docs/acceptance/t1441/logs/12-web-targeted-after-install.log
exit $code'

/bin/zsh -lc "{
  echo '"'$ go test ./...'"'
  go test ./...
} > docs/acceptance/t1441/logs/20-go-full.log 2>&1
code="'$?
tail -160 docs/acceptance/t1441/logs/20-go-full.log
exit $code'

/bin/zsh -lc "{
  echo '"'$ make test-race'"'
  make test-race
} > docs/acceptance/t1441/logs/21-test-race.log 2>&1
code="'$?
tail -120 docs/acceptance/t1441/logs/21-test-race.log
exit $code'

/bin/zsh -lc "{
  echo '"'$ GOMAXPROCS=2 GOFLAGS=-p=1 make test-race'"'
  GOMAXPROCS=2 GOFLAGS=-p=1 make test-race
} > docs/acceptance/t1441/logs/22-test-race-serial-rerun.log 2>&1
code="'$?
tail -160 docs/acceptance/t1441/logs/22-test-race-serial-rerun.log
exit $code'

/bin/zsh -lc "{ echo '"'$ ulimit -a'"'; ulimit -a; echo '"'$ ps count'"'; ps -A | wc -l; echo '"'$ pgrep go count'"'; pgrep -fl 'go|git|agent-center|vitest|node' | sed -n '1,120p'; } > docs/acceptance/t1441/logs/22a-process-snapshot-after-race-fail.log 2>&1; sed -n '1,180p' docs/acceptance/t1441/logs/22a-process-snapshot-after-race-fail.log"

/bin/zsh -lc "perl -0pi -e 's/acat_[A-Za-z0-9_\\-]+/[REDACTED_AGENT_CENTER_TOKEN]/g; s/--admin-token\\s+\\S+/--admin-token [REDACTED]/g; s/--api-key\\s+\\S+/--api-key [REDACTED]/g' docs/acceptance/t1441/logs/22a-process-snapshot-after-race-fail.log && { echo '"'$ wc -l docs/acceptance/t1441/logs/22a-process-snapshot-after-race-fail.log'"'; wc -l docs/acceptance/t1441/logs/22a-process-snapshot-after-race-fail.log; echo '"'$ rg -n "acat_|sk_machine|--admin-token [''^[]|--api-key [''^[]" docs/acceptance/t1441/logs/22a-process-snapshot-after-race-fail.log'"'; rg -n \"acat_|sk_machine|--admin-token ["'^[]|--api-key [''^[]" docs/acceptance/t1441/logs/22a-process-snapshot-after-race-fail.log || true; }'

/bin/zsh -lc "rm docs/acceptance/t1441/logs/22a-process-snapshot-after-race-fail.log
{
  echo '"'$ ulimit -u'"'
  ulimit -u
  echo '"'$ ulimit -n'"'
  ulimit -n
  echo '"'$ ps -A | wc -l'"'
  ps -A | wc -l
} > docs/acceptance/t1441/logs/22a-resource-counts-after-race-fail.log 2>&1
sed -n '1,80p' docs/acceptance/t1441/logs/22a-resource-counts-after-race-fail.log"

/bin/zsh -lc "{
  echo '"'$ go test -race -count=10 ./internal/authorization ./internal/team/service ./internal/webconsole/api ./internal/admin/api ./internal/workerdaemon'"'
  go test -race -count=10 ./internal/authorization ./internal/team/service ./internal/webconsole/api ./internal/admin/api ./internal/workerdaemon
} > docs/acceptance/t1441/logs/23-authz-race-focused.log 2>&1
code="'$?
tail -160 docs/acceptance/t1441/logs/23-authz-race-focused.log
exit $code'

/bin/zsh -lc "{
  echo '"'$ rg retired/profile residue in production paths'"'
  rg -n \"access_profiles|access_profile_versions|access/profiles|AccessProfile|access profile|Access Profile|Profiles tab|runtime\\.profiles|default_profile_key|ai_runtime_profiles|AI Runtime Profile\" internal web sites README* docs/acceptance docs/design docs/rules docs/releases
} > docs/acceptance/t1441/logs/30-static-profile-residue.log 2>&1
code="'$?
tail -220 docs/acceptance/t1441/logs/30-static-profile-residue.log
exit 0'

/bin/zsh -lc "{
  echo '"'$ rg RAM role contract surface'"'
  rg -n \"authorization_role_versions|authorization_roles|authorization_role_permissions|ram_role_ids|ram_role_keys|RAM Role|team_role_ram_role_mappings|authorization_role_assignments\" internal web docs/design docs/acceptance
} > docs/acceptance/t1441/logs/31-static-ram-surface.log 2>&1
code="'$?
tail -220 docs/acceptance/t1441/logs/31-static-ram-surface.log
exit 0'

/bin/zsh -lc "{
  echo '"'$ go test -list "T1438|T1413|T1416|RAM|Revoke|CAS|Effective|Permission|Auth|Profile|Background|MCP|HTTP|Web|Union|FailClosed|Deny|Forbidden" ./internal/authorization ./internal/team/service ./internal/webconsole/api ./internal/admin/api ./internal/mcphost ./internal/cli ./internal/workerdaemon ./internal/persistence'"'
  go test -list \"T1438|T1413|T1416|RAM|Revoke|CAS|Effective|Permission|Auth|Profile|Background|MCP|HTTP|Web|Union|FailClosed|Deny|Forbidden\" ./internal/authorization ./internal/team/service ./internal/webconsole/api ./internal/admin/api ./internal/mcphost ./internal/cli ./internal/workerdaemon ./internal/persistence
} > docs/acceptance/t1441/logs/32-test-inventory-authz.log 2>&1
code="'$?
tail -260 docs/acceptance/t1441/logs/32-test-inventory-authz.log
exit $code'

/bin/zsh -lc "{
  echo '"'$ make lint'"'
  make lint
} > docs/acceptance/t1441/logs/40-make-lint.log 2>&1
code="'$?
tail -180 docs/acceptance/t1441/logs/40-make-lint.log
exit $code'

/bin/zsh -lc "{
  echo '"'$ make build'"'
  make build
} > docs/acceptance/t1441/logs/41-make-build.log 2>&1
code="'$?
tail -180 docs/acceptance/t1441/logs/41-make-build.log
exit $code'

/bin/zsh -lc "{
  echo '"'$ make smoke'"'
  make smoke
} > docs/acceptance/t1441/logs/42-make-smoke.log 2>&1
code="'$?
tail -220 docs/acceptance/t1441/logs/42-make-smoke.log
exit $code'

/bin/zsh -lc "{
  echo '"'$ make e2e'"'
  make e2e
} > docs/acceptance/t1441/logs/43-make-e2e.log 2>&1
code="'$?
tail -260 docs/acceptance/t1441/logs/43-make-e2e.log
exit $code'
/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,120p' docs/acceptance/t1441/logs/43-make-e2e.log && printf '\\n--- tail ---\\n' && tail -220 docs/acceptance/t1441/logs/43-make-e2e.log"

/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n \"acat_|sk_machine|--admin-token\\s+\\S+|--api-key\\s+\\S+|server-fingerprint sha256:[A-Fa-f0-9:]|token=[REDACTED_SECRET] .*scope\" docs/acceptance/t1441 logs web tests/e2e/v2/artifacts 2>/dev/null || true"
/bin/zsh -lc 'git status --short --ignored=no'
/bin/zsh -lc 'find docs/acceptance/t1441 -type f -maxdepth 3 -print | sort'

/bin/zsh -lc 'git ls-files --others --exclude-standard tests/e2e/v2/artifacts/playwright-report > /tmp/t1441-untracked-artifacts.txt
while IFS= read -r f; do [ -n "$f" ] && rm "$f"; done < /tmp/t1441-untracked-artifacts.txt
git restore -- tests/e2e/v2/artifacts/playwright-report
git status --short --ignored=no'
/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n \"acat_|sk_machine|--admin-token\\s+\\S+|--api-key\\s+\\S+|token=[REDACTED_SECRET] Bearer|Bearer [A-Za-z0-9_\\-]{20,}|server-fingerprint=sha256\" docs/acceptance/t1441 || true"
/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,260p' docs/acceptance/t1441/report.md"
/bin/zsh -lc 'find docs/acceptance/t1441 -type f -print | sort && du -sh docs/acceptance/t1441'
/bin/zsh -lc 'git status --short --branch'
/bin/zsh -lc 'git add docs/acceptance/t1441 && git commit -m "test: add T1441 independent authz acceptance evidence" && git status --short --branch'
/bin/zsh -lc 'git push -u origin review/t1441-independent-authz-acceptance && git ls-remote origin refs/heads/review/t1441-independent-authz-acceptance && git status --short --branch'
/bin/zsh -lc "git config --get-regexp '"'^remote'"\\.origin\\.' && git branch -vv"
/bin/zsh -lc 'git remote show origin'

/bin/zsh -lc 'git -c remote.origin.mirror=false push -u origin HEAD:refs/heads/review/t1441-independent-authz-acceptance && git ls-remote origin refs/heads/review/t1441-independent-authz-acceptance && git status --short --branch'
